name: Internationalization & Localization
description: Internationalization & Localization standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-I18N applies.

rules.title: Externalize user-facing text
rules.detail: User-visible strings belong in locale resources except content intentionally managed by backend/CMS; do not concatenate translated sentence fragments.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Externalize user-facing text.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Externalize user-facing text.

rules.title: Use locale-aware formatting for dates, numbers and currency
rules.detail: Formatting must use the user/business locale and explicit timezone/currency rules rather than string templates.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Use locale-aware formatting for dates, numbers and currency.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Use locale-aware formatting for dates, numbers and currency.

rules.title: Design layouts for text expansion and bidirectional content
rules.detail: UI must tolerate longer translations and support RTL when required without clipping or fixed-width assumptions.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Design layouts for text expansion and bidirectional content.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Design layouts for text expansion and bidirectional content.

rules.title: Use stable translation keys and fallback behavior
rules.detail: Keys describe meaning rather than source text; missing translations use a defined fallback and are detectable before release.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Use stable translation keys and fallback behavior.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Use stable translation keys and fallback behavior.

rules.title: Do not localize machine contracts
rules.detail: API field names, enum codes and log/event identifiers remain stable; translate presentation labels separately.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Do not localize machine contracts.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Do not localize machine contracts.

rules.title: Test representative locales
rules.detail: Include at least one long-text locale and, when in scope, RTL and non-Latin scripts in visual/regression testing.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Test representative locales.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Test representative locales.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-I18N applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Internationalization & Localization to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Internationalization & Localization is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Internationalization & Localization failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
